column3: Close to the Hebrew; “your burdens” is rendered “Your carriages.”
Close to the Hebrew; “carried from the belly” is rendered “upheld by Me from birth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “pour out” is rendered “lavish,” and “metalsmith” “goldsmith.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְהִתְאֹשָׁשׁוּ (obscure) is rendered “show yourselves men,” and “bring it back on heart” “Recall to mind.”
Close to the Hebrew; “purpose” is rendered “counsel,” and “will be fulfilled” “shall stand.”
Close to the Hebrew; “mighty of heart” is rendered “stubborn-hearted.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “For,” “For Israel My glory.”
